title: Zeta Surgical® AI-powered TMS Navigation System Receives FDA 510(k) Clearance
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Zeta Surgical today announced that its Zeta TMS Navigation System has received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration...
body_text: BOSTON , Oct. 13, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Zeta Surgical today announced that its Zeta TMS Navigation System has received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The device is classified as a Class II stereotaxic instrument (21 CFR 882.4560) under product codes SGE and QFF (K251927). Continue Reading Zeta Surgical® Navigation System (PRNewsfoto/Zeta Surgical) The Zeta TMS Navigation System provides image‑guided, real‑time coil positioning for transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). The system combines 3D imaging and motion‑aware tracking to help maintain target alignment during patient movement. TMS is widely used in neuropsychiatry, particularly for treatment-resistant major depressive disorder (TR-MDD), which affects about one-third of patients with major depression worldwide. The FDA clearance covers use of the Zeta TMS Navigation System as a stereotaxic image‑guidance system for accurate positioning of TMS treatment coils to planned brain targets using 3D patient imaging, for use by trained professionals in clinical environments—supporting deployment across a range of TMS procedures including therapeutic sessions and functional mapping. "This clearance classifies the system under product codes QFF and SGE—and, to our knowledge, marks the first TMS navigation device cleared under SGE," said Hieu Le Mau, Chief Operating Officer at Zeta Surgical. "It provides a clear regulatory pathway for broader adoption." Zeta Surgical recently completed a study in collaboration with the University of Cambridge and Harvard Medical School demonstrating sub‑millimeter translational and sub‑degree angular precision in bench, phantom, and cadaver testing for navigated TMS using its system. "We expect this clearance to help clinics deliver more consistent targeting in TMS, which has been shown in research to significantly improve treatment efficacy," said Jose Maria Amich, Co‑Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Zeta Surgical. "Our aim is to make stereotactic-grade, high‑accuracy image guidance practical in everyday neuromodulation workflows." About Zeta Surgical Zeta Surgical is redefining the standard of care for image‑guided surgery. Its navigation and robotics platform applies advanced AI to enable high‑accuracy image guidance across any point‑of‑care in minutes, unlocking less invasive, more precise targeted therapies. The Zeta Surgical Cranial Navigation System is cleared by the FDA and commercially available in the U.S. Learn more at www.zetasurgical.com . title: How Quanex Creates Energy Efficient, Comfortable Spaces Worldwide
summary: See how Quanex products help create energy efficient homes and buildings that enhance comfort, performance, and sustainability worldwide.
body_text: How Quanex Enhances Occupancy Comfort Around the World Quanex can be found within countless applications in homes and commercial buildings everywhere. See how our products contribute to more comfortable, energy efficient living and working environments. Living and working spaces have evolved in countless ways over time. Today’s modern built environment represents a confluence of cutting-edge technologies designed to enhance the occupant experience. Quanex is everywhere you look in these settings—and it’s how we’re A Part of Something Bigger for our customers and their customers. Whether it’s helping to create a more energy-efficient building envelope, enabling the use of advanced architectural glass, or contributing to more aesthetically appealing interiors, Quanex is a part of it all. Here’s a look at how our teams are helping to deliver greater occupancy comfort all around the world. Complete Fenestration Energy Efficiency High-performance fenestration products are an essential part of creating more energy efficient—and more comfortable—interior environments. In residential and commercial applications, today’s windows and doors are tasked with delivering outstanding thermal performance, and Quanex has been helping advance this technology for many years. For example, our warm-edge insulating glass spacer technology—including our industry-leading Super Spacer® and Duralite® brands—has contributed to more effective, energy efficient glass and windows for decades by reducing heat transfer. Our Mikron® brand vinyl window and door profiles have further made an impact, bringing total efficiency to new heights in window units everywhere. It all makes for more comfortable interiors that maintain more consistent temperatures by eliminating drafts, minimizing cold and hot zones, and reducing reliance on continuous HVAC activity. Further, when homes and buildings can incorporate a greater number of high-performing windows, it allows more natural light without discomfort. Daylight exposure is linked to better mood, altertness, and even healthier sleep patterns—benefits particularly important in workplaces, schools, and health care settings. “We’ve worked long and hard at making a real, tangible impact on commercial and residential structures everywhere,” said Joe Erb, solutions sales manager, Quanex. “We were pioneers in introducing warm-edge spacers to the market when every spacer used to that point was made from aluminum or other metal. And we’ve continued to push those boundaries with our spacers and commercial vinyl products. It’s part of who we are—we’re challenging the status quo, and we’re delivering critical components for higher-performing building envelopes.” Outside In. Bugs and Intruders Out. Windows and doors help maintain interior comfort in more ways than one. And Quanex’s screens are another clear example. With a full portfolio of high-performance window and door screens, Quanex enhances fenestration products by letting more of the outside in, improving interior airflow and filtering sunlight, all while keeping unwanted intruders out. Of course, screen protection includes bugs and pests, but with the addition of our proprietary Meshtec® technology, Quanex Fortify Security Screens can also provide greater peace of mind for homeowners. These products resist common intrusion methods and are readily available as consumers everywhere are increasingly focused on home security options. Quanex also makes it easy for window and door manufacturers looking for screens to do business with us. “Our recently launched Screens+ program helps assure window and door OEMs that they can satisfy their customers with high-quality, high-performance screens for every window and door that leaves their facility,” said Carrie Scheetz, marketing manager, Quanex. “With Screens+, we provide an elevated level of service that isn’t available from other screens suppliers.” It’s in the details High-performance glass, glazing, and framing go a long way toward creating more comfortable interiors. But a wide range of additional components completes the picture. Throughout our portfolio, customers will find a broad range of thresholds and weather seals that help better protect interiors. Gaps and cracks beneath and around doors can allow unwanted drafts, pests, noise, moisture, and other nuisances to enter the home—and Quanex provides numerous prevention solutions. Further, thresholds provide a smooth transition that minimizes fall risk and maximizes safety. “With our threshold and weather seal offerings, we’re providing the total package to both our OEM customers and homeowners,” said Mike Dorsey, channel sales director, Quanex. “Overall, Quanex has a broad portfolio that stands up to all for today’s high-performance window and door needs for creating greater efficiency and occupancy comfort.” Enabling High-End Aesthetic Appeal High-performance fenestration products contribute to more than just energy efficiency and comfort—they can elevate the aesthetics of any home or building. For example, Many homeowners are embracing large-format windows and doors with thinner profiles to maximize glass exposure, creating dramatic effects that allow more of an outside in. And our AmesburyTruth brand is helping support these trends with new product development. “As glass gets bigger and heavier, the completed window or door unit requires optimal hardware to support it,” said Angie Hennessy, director of product management for patio doors, AmesburyTruth. “For example, a large-format patio door might require the distribution of weight over more rollers than traditional applications. It’s just one trend we’re supporting with high-quality products that make forward-looking, desirable door products possible.” Beyond these capabilities, high-performance hardware is how all windows and doors maintain easy and convenient functionality while keeping pace with consumer trends. “Aligning hardware with consumer preferences is a big part of what our team tries to accomplish, and it must be done while remaining highly functional,” Angie added. “Some window and door OEMs are seeking seamless, integrated hardware. Others are seeking statement items that add pizzazz to statement pieces. It’s all about ensuring form and function work in harmony with a product that homeowners will cherish for years to come.” There’s more to the hardware story, too. Throughout the Quanex portfolio, there are a wide range of handles, locks, latches, hinges, and more that provide optimal aesthetic appeal. This enables window and door OEMs to deliver on a breadth of consumer preferences and desired styles, creating beautiful and functional interiors. Of course, function must match aesthetics, and Quanex delivers. Our hardware portfolio delivers optimal functionality, user friendliness, and high performance for critical applications. For example, our handle and Smart Lock technology enhance security and door longevity as well as convenience. “We’ve developed multipoint lock technology that not only provides security, but helps customers meet stringent requirements while providing enhanced user friendliness,” Angie said. “Multipoint locks can prevent doors from bowing and warping, and can meet elevated standards for air and water intrusion.” Modern interiors wouldn’t be as secure, efficient, and comfortable without Quanex. It’s what being A Part of Something Bigger is all about. Stay connected with us to continue learning about how Quanex is making a difference.

title: Laser Photonics and Quantum Technology Exhibit Jointly at ICALEO 2025 in Orlando, Florida

body_text: Laser Photonics Corporation ( NASDAQ: LASE ), a leading global developer of industrial laser systems for cleaning, marking, cutting, and other precision material processing applications, participated in the International Congress on Applications of Lasers & Electro-Optics (ICALEO) 2025 , held in Orlando, Florida. The company attended the event in partnership with Quantum Technology , Inc., an establis hed developer of electro-optical devices that power advanced laser systems and experimental research. Elizaveta Smirnova , Marketing Director at Fonon Technologies, Sanjay Adhav , Senior Vice President of Technology at Quantum Technology, and Igor Vodopyanov , Vice President of Research & Development at Laser Photonics represented both companies and exhibited alongside other well-known laser technology companies across the nation. Together, the team showcased the companies’ combined expertise in industrial laser innovation, automation, and precision engineering. ICALEO 2025, organized by the Laser Institute of America (LIA), is one of the most prestigious gatherings in the global laser industry bringing together experts from research, academia, and manufacturing to discuss the latest advancements in laser applications, optics, and photonics. Over the course of four days, ICALEO 2025 featured a series of sessions and presentations from leading experts in laser science and engineering. Notable topics included innovation in directed energy, dynamic beam shaping, precision and ultrafast laser processing, and advances in digital processes for additive manufacturing. During the event, the Laser Photonics and Quantum Technology team had the opportunity to connect with key industry professionals and potential collaborators. Notable meetings included Tom Klopcic , National Sales Director at Lasermet Inc., with whom we highlighted the growing impact of laser technology and the importance of developing proper laser safety equipment in accordance with the necessary state compliance regulations. We also connected with Jessica Wilson , Director of Economic Development for Central Florida, with whom we discussed potential partnership opportunities that can help support our company’s growth through connections in academia, industry, and government, in-depth market data, internship pipelines and more. In addition, the team engaged with faculty and students from the University of Central Florida’s CREOL College of Optics & Photonics , one of the nation’s leading institutions for photonics research and education. Aaron Eades , Director of Partnerships in Marketing and Communications at CREOL, provided valuable insight into potential internship and hiring opportunities helping to bridge the gap between academic talent and industry innovation. “ICALEO 2025 was a tremendous opportunity for networking with both the academic and industrial communities driving the next generation of laser technology,” said Elizaveta Smirnova , Marketing Director of Fonon Technologies. “We are excited to continue fostering relationships that support workforce development, collaboration, and the advancement of photonic manufacturing.” Laser Photonics and Quantum Technology’s joint participation at ICALEO 2025 underscores their shared commitment to advancing laser innovation, promoting sustainable manufacturing practices, and strengthening ties with research institutions and technology partners.

title: The Hidden Advantage of Smart Keys with Dedicated LED Indicators
summary: Unlock greater efficiency with Turtle Beach 24 Smart Keys featuring dedicated LED indicators and customizable shortcut keys.
body_text: Your competitive streak demands every advantage possible. Split-second reactions, flawless execution, and seamless workflow optimization separate victories from defeats. While most gamers and professionals focus on specs like polling rates and switch types, there's a game-changing feature hiding in plain sight: programmable smart keys with dedicated LED indicators . The Turtle Beach Vulcan II Max exemplifies this innovation , combining advanced TITAN II Optical Switches with 24 smart keys featuring dedicated LED indicators that transform how you interact with your setup. But what exactly makes programmable keys with LED feedback so powerful for both gaming dominance and workplace productivity? What are Programmable Keys and LED Indicators? Programmable smart keys are advanced macro keys that can be configured to perform custom, user-defined behavior beyond their standard function. Unlike traditional function keys, these programmable keys can execute complex sequences, launch applications, control multimedia functions, or trigger intricate gaming combos with a single press. The Vulcan II series features dual-LED smart keys that provide real-time visual feedback for each key's current state and function. The Vulcan II Max includes 24 smart keys with dedicated LED indicators, while the Mini Air features 29 dual-LED smart keys that indicate when secondary functions are active. The magic happens when these technologies combine with Easy-Shift[+]™ button duplicator technology, which unlocks a second programmable function layer. Instead of memorizing which key does what, your keyboard visually communicates its current configuration through dedicated LED feedback. Gaming Advantages of LED-Driven Controls Instant Visual Confirmation In competitive gaming, milliseconds matter. Research confirms that average keyboard latency ranges between 3-15ms depending on switch type and connection, with best gaming keyboards achieving latency under 10ms for competitive play . Programmable keys with LED feedback can help reduce the cognitive processing time needed to identify key functions during intense moments. Picture this: you're in a clutch 1v3 situation in your favorite FPS. Your customizable shortcut keys are mapped to grenades, utility, and movement combos. Instead of glancing at your keyboard to verify which key triggers which action, dedicated LED indicators instantly confirm your loadout configuration. Advanced Macro Execution with Easy-Shift[+]™ The Easy-Shift[+]™ technology allows users to "unlock a second function layer which can be programmed into near limitless options" on both Vulcan II models. This effectively doubles the functionality of your programmable keys while LED indicators show which layer is currently active. Consider MMO gaming: your programmable keys can trigger 8-skill rotations, buff combinations, or raid coordination commands. LEDs pulse during casting, change color when abilities are on cooldown, or flash to indicate resource depletion. This real-time feedback keeps you in the action rather than staring at cooldown timers. Peripheral Integration Modern gaming setups benefit from ecosystem integration. When paired with Turtle Beach headsets like the Stealth 700 Gen 3, programmable keys can control audio profiles, activate noise cancellation, or adjust chat/game audio balance without alt-tabbing. LED indicators show which audio profile is active: competitive, cinematic, or streaming modes. Productivity Benefits in Professional Workflows Visual Status Indicators The AIMO™ RGB lighting technology in both Vulcan II models produces smooth and vibrant lighting effects with 16.8 million colors. The Vulcan II Max features "double the refresh rate of a standard gaming keyboard" for enhanced visual feedback. This advanced lighting system extends productivity benefits by providing context-aware visual feedback. Professional video editors working with complex timelines benefit from programmable keys mapped to rendering processes, export settings, or timeline navigation. LEDs indicate rendering progress, pulsing during processing, solid when complete, or flashing red if errors occur. Workflow Optimization Keyboard Features Both keyboards feature on-board storage for up to 5 profiles of custom lighting and key assignments. Content creators juggling multiple applications simultaneously gain advantages from programmable key configurations. One key might switch between recording software, streaming platforms, and editing suites, with LEDs indicating which application profile is currently active. Software developers can map programmable keys to different development environments, version control systems, or testing frameworks. Green LEDs confirm successful builds, red indicates compilation errors, and blue shows active debugging sessions, all without switching windows. Meeting and Communication Control Remote work professionals benefit from multimedia control smart keys that manage video calls, screen sharing, and presentation modes. LEDs provide instant feedback: red when muted, green when the camera is active, blue during screen sharing. This visual confirmation prevents embarrassing hot-mic incidents during important calls. Comparing Traditional Shortcut Keys vs. Programmable Keys Traditional keyboards rely on function key combinations (Fn+F1, Ctrl+Alt+S) that require memorization and multiple simultaneous presses. This cognitive overhead can slow execution and increase error rates during high-pressure situations. The Vulcan II series eliminates this friction through several key advantages: Single-Press Execution : Complex operations become one-touch actions through Easy-Shift[+]™ technology. Instead of Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F12 to trigger scene switching, one programmable key press accomplishes the same result. Context Awareness : The dual-LED indicators adapt to current applications or system states. Your programmable keys might control media when browsing, switch to game-specific functions during gaming, or provide editing shortcuts when rendering. Profile Switching : Different LED patterns indicate active profiles stored in the 4MB on-board memory. Gaming profile shows weapon shortcuts, productivity profile displays application launchers, and creative profile reveals editing tools. Real-Time Status : Unlike static labels, LEDs communicate dynamic information. Recording status, system performance, network connectivity, or application states becomes immediately visible. Real-World Use Cases In Creative Software, Editing, and Streaming Content Creation Workflows Professional streamers benefit enormously from the dedicated media controls featured on the Vulcan II Max , including a push-to-mute volume knob. Programmable keys can control streaming scenes, audio sources, stream overlays, and chat moderation simultaneously. LEDs indicate recording status, live broadcast, or idle mode. Video editors working with Adobe Premiere or DaVinci Resolve map programmable keys to frequently-used effects, transitions, or export presets. LEDs show render queue status, project saves, or proxy generation progress without interrupting creative flow. The translucent detachable palm rest on the Vulcan II Max "sets the stage for vibrant AIMO RGB lighting displays", creating an immersive lighting experience that extends beyond the keyboard itself. Gaming Content Creation Gaming content creators need seamless transitions between gameplay and production modes. Programmable keys enable instant switching between gaming profiles and streaming configurations. When activated, LEDs shift from game-specific shortcuts (green) to broadcast controls (purple), immediately signaling the mode change. Professional Audio Production Audio engineers and podcasters benefit from programmable key integration with professional audio workflows. Keys can trigger recording starts/stops, apply real-time effects, or adjust gain levels across multiple channels. LEDs provide immediate visual feedback for recording status, input levels, or processing states. When combined with premium headsets like the Atlas Air , programmable keys can adjust monitoring levels , switch between multiple audio sources, or activate communication channels during collaborative recording sessions. How LED Feedback Enhances Speed and Accuracy Reduced Mental Processing Time Research shows that LED lighting with proper color temperature and adequate luminance can improve work performance at visual and cognitive tasks by 8.34% compared to traditional lighting. While this research focused on general lighting, the principle of visual cues reducing cognitive load applies to keyboard LED indicators as well. Instead of mentally tracking which keys perform which functions, visual cues can help eliminate guesswork. This reduction in mental processing allows faster decision-making during critical moments, whether landing a clutch play or meeting a tight deadline. Ergonomic keyboard shortcuts Integration Programmable keys positioned within natural hand reach zones minimize finger travel and reduce repetitive strain. LEDs guide users toward optimal key usage patterns, encouraging ergonomic hand positioning while providing functional feedback. Muscle Memory Development Consistent LED patterns can accelerate muscle memory formation. Users may develop associations between colors and functions, creating instinctive responses. Purple always means streaming mode, green indicates gaming, and blue represents productivity. This visual consistency could translate to faster execution speeds. Multi-Device Ecosystem Integration Modern workflows span multiple devices and platforms. Keyboards with programmable keys and LED indicators can serve as command centers that manage entire setups rather than single applications. Consider a professional streaming setup : programmable keys control the primary gaming PC, secondary streaming rig, audio mixer, lighting systems, and camera equipment. LEDs provide status updates across the entire ecosystem: green when all systems are operational, amber during transitions, red for equipment failures. The Vulcan II Mini Air demonstrates versatility by supporting multiple device connections while maintaining programmable key functionality across different platforms. Why Multiple Programmable Keys Provide Advantages A substantial number of programmable keys provides comprehensive workflow control without overwhelming users with excessive choices. The Vulcan II Max offers 24 smart keys, while the Mini Air provides 29 dual-LED smart keys. This approach accommodates different user needs and preferences. Gaming Applications : Multiple programmable keys can accommodate complete MMO ability bars, RTS unit groups, FPS loadout configurations, and utility functions simultaneously. LEDs can display cooldown states, resource costs, or availability status for each function. Professional Benefits : Content creators can map functions across recording, editing, publishing, and communication workflows. Software developers gain access to debugging tools, compilation shortcuts, version control, and testing frameworks through single-key activation. Creative Workflows : Digital artists and video editors benefit from quick access to brushes, effects, timeline controls, and export options. LEDs indicate active tools, processing status, or project states throughout complex creative processes. The Hidden Advantages of Advanced Programmable Keys The convergence of programmable smart keys, dedicated LED indicators, and Easy-Shift[+]™ technology creates productivity and performance advantages that extend beyond traditional keyboard functionality. Whether dominating competitive gaming sessions, streamlining professional workflows, or creating engaging content, the Vulcan II series keyboards with LED feedback help reduce the mental overhead of tracking complex key assignments. The visual confirmation provided by dual-LED systems may reduce errors, potentially accelerate decision-making, and enable complex operations through simple interactions. This isn't just about having more buttons; it's about transforming how you interact with your digital environment through intelligent, visually-guided control. As gaming becomes more competitive and professional demands increase, the edge provided by intelligent keyboard control may become more pronounced. Programmable keys with LED indicators don't just keep up with these demands; they enable new levels of performance optimization through technologies like Easy-Shift[+]™ and AIMO™ lighting integration. Your next upgrade isn't just about better switches or faster polling rates. Consider how advanced keyboards like the Turtle Beach Vulcan II Max and Vulcan II Mini Air can enhance every aspect of your digital experience through intelligent, visually guided programmable control. FAQ What are smart keys on a keyboard? Smart keys are programmable keys that can be customized to perform specific functions like launching applications, executing complex macro sequences, controlling multimedia, or triggering gaming combos. The Vulcan II series keyboards feature 24-29 smart keys with dedicated LED indicators and Easy-Shift[+]™ technology for expanded functionality. How do LED indicators improve keyboard usability? The dual-LED system in Vulcan II keyboards shows which keys are active, what functions are currently mapped, and the status of Easy-Shift[+]™ layers, all without requiring users to memorize complex key assignments. title: From Billable Hours to Smart Hours
summary: For decades, the legal profession has been measured by one metric: the billable hour. Every six-minute increment defines value, productivity, and performance. But in a world where technology can automate, summarize, and draft faster than ever before — is time still the right measure of worth? At Lexi, we believe it’s time to rethink what “productive” means in law. Because efficiency isn’t about billing more hours — it’s about doing smarter work in fewer hours.
body_text: Back to Blog Legal Tech AI From Billable Hours to Smart Hours Harshit Garg October 29, 2025 10 min read For decades, the legal profession has been measured by one metric: the billable hour. Every six-minute increment defines value, productivity, and performance. But in a world where technology can automate, summarize, and draft faster than ever before — is time still the right measure of worth? At Lexi, we believe it’s time to rethink what “productive” means in law. Because efficiency isn’t about billing more hours — it’s about doing smarter work in fewer hours. From Billable Hours to Smart Hours: Rethinking Legal Productivity in the Age of AI For more than half a century, the billable hour has been the economic backbone of legal practice. It determines how law firms price their services, how associates prove their worth, and how clients budget for legal spend. But as artificial intelligence reshapes every knowledge-intensive profession, the billable hour model is facing its most serious challenge yet. This article explores the history of time-based billing, why it persists despite its flaws, and how AI-powered tools are enabling a fundamental shift from effort-based to outcome-based legal work — what we call the move from billable hours to smart hours . The Billable Hour: A Brief History The billable hour was not always the norm. Before the 1960s, most lawyers charged flat fees or retainer-based arrangements. The shift to hourly billing was driven by the American Bar Association's 1958 economics report, which highlighted that lawyers were under-earning relative to other professionals. Tracking time became the recommended path to fair compensation. By the 1970s, the billable hour had become standard across the legal industry. Firms began setting annual targets — 1,800, then 2,000, then even 2,200 hours — and the metric became inseparable from career advancement. Associates who billed more hours advanced faster. Partners who generated more billable revenue earned more. The model made sense in a pre-digital world where legal work was inherently labor-intensive. Research meant physical libraries. Document review meant paper. Communication meant letters and phone calls. Every task genuinely required significant human time. But the world has changed. The work has not — at least, not as fast as it should have. Why the Billable Hour Persists Despite decades of criticism, the billable hour endures for several practical reasons: Predictable revenue: For firm management, time-based billing offers a straightforward way to forecast income and allocate resources. Client expectations: Many corporate legal departments have built their budgets and outside counsel guidelines around hourly rates and estimated hours. Cultural inertia: The billable hour is deeply embedded in firm culture, from hiring and promotion decisions to compensation structures. Simplicity: Despite its flaws, tracking time is conceptually simple compared to designing and negotiating value-based fee arrangements. But the cracks are widening. Clients increasingly push back on invoices that reflect effort rather than results. Associates burn out chasing hour targets. And the most damaging consequence: the billable hour actively discourages efficiency . The Problem With Billable Thinking The billable hour was designed for accountability, not innovation. It rewards effort, not outcomes — and in doing so, it quietly discourages progress. Lawyers hesitate to automate tasks that could save time. Junior lawyers spend hours on routine work just to meet targets. Clients question fees that no longer align with modern efficiency. The result? A profession caught between tradition and transformation — working harder, not smarter. Consider the economics: if an associate uses AI to complete a contract review in 30 minutes instead of 4 hours, the firm potentially loses 3.5 hours of billable time. Under the current model, there is a direct financial disincentive to adopt technology that makes lawyers more efficient. This paradox is at the heart of the billable hour problem. How AI Changes the Equation Artificial intelligence is not replacing lawyers. That narrative misses the point entirely. What AI does is remove the mechanical work so that lawyers can focus on what actually requires legal judgment, creativity, and human empathy. The distinction matters. A lawyer who spends 6 hours reviewing a 200-page contract is not spending 6 hours exercising legal judgment. Much of that time is spent reading, cross-referencing, formatting, and identifying standard clauses — tasks that AI handles with remarkable accuracy and speed. When AI takes over the mechanical layer, what remains is the genuinely valuable work: analyzing risk, advising on strategy, negotiating terms, and making judgment calls that require experience and context. This is the work clients are actually paying for — and the work lawyers are trained to do. Real Examples of Time Savings Across law firms adopting AI-powered tools, the time savings are consistent and measurable: Document review: AI can analyze and summarize large document sets in minutes rather than hours. A due diligence package that once required two associates working three days can be initially processed in under an hour, with AI flagging key provisions, risks, and anomalies for attorney review. Legal research: AI-assisted research tools can surface relevant case law, statutes, and secondary sources in a fraction of the time traditional research requires. What once took a junior associate half a day can be accomplished in 15 to 20 minutes, with higher accuracy and broader coverage. Contract drafting and review: AI tools like Lexi can generate first drafts based on templates and prior work product, identify non-standard clauses, flag missing provisions, and suggest alternative language — reducing initial contract review time by 60 to 80 percent. Correspondence and memos: AI can draft client communications, internal memos, and case summaries based on matter context, significantly reducing the time spent on routine writing tasks. Compliance monitoring: AI can continuously monitor regulatory changes and flag relevant updates, replacing the manual process of tracking and reviewing regulatory developments. Enter the Era of Smart Hours The next evolution of legal productivity is not about time — it is about value . Smart Hours measure what truly matters: The quality and strategic impact of your work. The insights you deliver, not the minutes you record. The human judgment that no algorithm can replicate. With the right technology, lawyers can spend less time drafting, formatting, or searching — and more time analyzing, reasoning, and advising. That is what smart work looks like. The Shift From Effort-Based to Outcome-Based Billing As AI makes lawyers more efficient, the economic model must evolve. Forward-thinking firms are already experimenting with alternative fee arrangements (AFAs) that better align firm incentives with client outcomes: Fixed fees: A set price for a defined scope of work, rewarding efficiency rather than penalizing it. Capped fees: An hourly rate with a maximum, giving clients budget certainty while allowing firms to benefit from efficiency gains. Success-based fees: Compensation tied to outcomes — whether that is a successful closing, a favorable settlement, or a compliance milestone. Subscription models: Monthly retainers for ongoing legal support, where the firm benefits from handling work efficiently across the portfolio. In each of these models, AI-driven efficiency is an asset, not a liability. The faster and more accurately a firm can deliver results, the more profitable the engagement becomes — and the happier the client. How Firms Successfully Transition: Practical Steps Moving from billable hours to smart hours does not happen overnight. It requires deliberate changes to technology, culture, and business model. Here is a practical roadmap: Audit your current workflows: Identify which tasks consume the most associate time and have the highest potential for AI augmentation. Document review, research, and first-draft generation are common starting points. Pilot AI tools on specific matters: Select two or three matter types and run AI tools alongside traditional workflows. Measure the time savings, quality differences, and attorney satisfaction. Redesign compensation metrics: Begin incorporating quality and outcome metrics alongside billable hours. Recognize and reward attorneys who leverage technology to deliver better results faster. Communicate with clients: Proactively discuss how AI adoption benefits them — faster turnaround, more consistent quality, and potentially lower costs. Many clients will welcome the transparency. Introduce alternative fee arrangements gradually: Start by offering fixed-fee options for well-defined, repeatable work such as contract review or regulatory filings. Use data from your AI tools to price these arrangements accurately. Invest in training: Ensure every attorney understands how to use AI tools effectively. The lawyers who master AI-assisted workflows will be the most productive and valuable members of your team. How Lexi Enables Smart Hours Lexi was built to redefine productivity for the modern lawyer. Automated Groundwork Lexi handles repetitive, document-heavy tasks like drafting, summaries, and clause analysis — freeing up time for critical thinking. Context-Aware Intelligence Unlike generic AI tools, Lexi understands matters, clients, and jurisdictions — ensuring every output is legally and ethically sound. Integrated Workflows From intake to final draft, Lexi connects your entire legal process so that no time is wasted switching between tools. Traceable Efficiency Every task is logged and explainable — not just faster, but verifiably smarter . The Shift from Hours to Outcomes Firms that embrace AI-powered systems like Lexi are discovering a new kind of competitiveness. They deliver more in less time — not by cutting corners, but by focusing their expertise where it matters most. Clients notice it. Teams feel it. The firms that adapt are not losing billable time — they are redefining what clients pay for : insight, precision, and results. The Future of Legal Productivity As AI reshapes how we work, the firms that thrive will be those that measure productivity not by time spent , but by value delivered . At Lexi, we call this the move from billable hours to smart hours — a shift that empowers lawyers to focus on the human side of law, while AI takes care of the mechanical. Because the future of legal practice is not about working more. It is about working brilliantly. Frequently Asked Questions Will AI eliminate the billable hour entirely? Not immediately, and perhaps not entirely. The billable hour will likely remain relevant for certain types of work, particularly complex litigation and bespoke advisory matters. However, AI is accelerating the shift toward alternative fee arrangements for repeatable, process-driven work. The firms that thrive will be those that offer clients flexibility — using the billable hour where it makes sense and outcome-based pricing where it delivers better value for both parties. How do I convince firm leadership to invest in AI when it could reduce billable revenue? Frame AI as a competitive necessity, not a revenue threat. Firms that adopt AI can handle more matters with the same team, improve client satisfaction, and win new business through faster turnaround and competitive pricing. The revenue does not disappear — it shifts from volume-based to value-based. Present pilot data showing that AI-assisted attorneys can take on 30 to 50 percent more matters, more than offsetting any per-matter reduction in billable hours. Is AI-generated legal work reliable enough for client-facing deliverables? AI should be viewed as a first-draft tool that accelerates the starting point, not a replacement for attorney review. The most effective workflow uses AI to generate initial analysis, flag issues, and draft documents, with an experienced attorney reviewing, refining, and approving the final output. This human-in-the-loop approach ensures quality while capturing the efficiency gains. Tools like Lexi are specifically designed for legal workflows, with built-in safeguards, citation verification, and jurisdiction-aware outputs. Ready to Make the Shift? title: The Rise of Leverless Controllers: Why More Pros Are Switching Away from Arcade Joysticks
summary: Learn why more pro players are embracing Turtle Beach leverless controllers for fighting games. Explore the benefits, performance gains, and how leverle...
body_text: Professional fighting game tournaments are witnessing a revolutionary shift. At EVO 2024, legendary players swapped their traditional arcade sticks for leverless controllers , fundamentally changing how competitive fighting games are played. Players like Daigo Umehara have made the transition from arcade sticks to leverless controllers at major tournaments, signaling a significant evolution in competitive gaming hardware. This isn't just a trend; it's a fundamental reimagining of fighting game control. Leverless controller vs arcade joystick comparisons show clear advantages in speed , precision, and ergonomics that are drawing professional players away from decades-old arcade stick traditions. Understanding this shift helps explain why the best leverless fighting game controller options are becoming essential tools for serious competitors. What Are Leverless Controllers? Leverless controllers represent a radical departure from traditional fighting game hardware . Unlike traditional fight sticks, leverless controllers eliminate the joystick component and rely solely on buttons for inputs, aiming to enhance input consistency and reduce the likelihood of missed moves during gameplay. Instead of using a physical joystick for directional movement, these controllers use four discrete buttons, typically arranged as left, down, right, and up. The closest approximation to a leverless controller is a keyboard with arcade-style buttons, but leverless controllers are truly their own unique input device. The right side features familiar arcade buttons for attacks, while the left side replaces the traditional joystick with directional buttons that provide digital precision for every movement command. This button-based fighting game controller design eliminates the analog stick's potential for imprecision, ensuring that every directional input registers exactly as intended. For competitive players, this consistency can be the difference between landing critical combos and missing tournament-winning opportunities. The Victrix Pro KO Leverless Fight Stick represents the premium tier of leverless controllers, featuring tournament-grade components and official PlayStation licensing for competitive events. Why Pros Are Switching Away from Arcade Joysticks The professional fighting game community's migration to leverless controllers stems from measurable competitive advantages, though adoption has been more gradual than revolutionary. At EVO 2024, champions achieved victory using different controller types, demonstrating that leverless controllers have reached competitive parity with traditional arcade sticks. However, according to tournament analysis from fighting game community experts, professional fighting game players remain divided across all three controller types rather than unanimously switching to leverless options. Execution Speed : Leverless controllers allow zero travel time between inputs, making tight combos like drive rush cancels much easier compared to pads or arcade sticks. Traditional joysticks require physical movement between positions, while button presses provide instantaneous directional changes. Consistency : Physical joysticks can develop dead zones, wear patterns, and mechanical inconsistencies over time. Button-based fighting game controllers eliminate these variables, providing an identical input response regardless of usage patterns or environmental conditions. Ergonomic Benefits : Extended tournament play demands comfortable hand positioning. Leverless controllers' button-only design helps players avoid strain and fatigue in their hands and wrists, allowing for longer and more comfortable gaming sessions. This ergonomic advantage becomes crucial during marathon tournament days. The adoption isn't without controversy. Capcom's rule changes for Street Fighter 6 specifically addressed leverless controller advantages around Simultaneous Opposing Cardinal Directions (SOCD), ensuring competitive balance between different controller types. Key Advantages of Leverless Controllers: Precision, Speed, and Ergonomics Precise Fighting Game Inputs Traditional arcade joysticks require analog-to-digital conversion, creating potential for input errors during rapid directional changes. Leverless controllers provide pure digital inputs with no conversion lag or interpretation errors. By remapping joystick movements as buttons, these controllers provide greater precision and accuracy in executing moves, especially complex inputs. This precision advantage is particularly noticeable in charge characters and complex motion inputs. Where traditional sticks might register incomplete quarter-circles or half-circles, leverless controllers ensure each directional component is perfectly executed. Unmatched Input Speed Esports leverless controllers enable input sequences impossible on traditional hardware. Frame-perfect combos become more achievable when directional changes require only button presses rather than joystick travel time. Professional players report improved consistency in executing complex combo sequences that previously required extensive practice to perform reliably on arcade sticks. Tournament-Ready Ergonomics Professional gaming demands equipment that won't cause fatigue during extended play sessions. Unlike traditional arcade sticks that require wrist movement for joystick manipulation, leverless controllers allow players to keep their hands in a neutral position. This reduces repetitive strain and enables more comfortable play during lengthy tournament brackets. Popular Models and Pro Endorsements Professional-Grade Options At the 2025 Evo Awards ceremony in February 2025, which honored achievements from 2024, the Victrix Pro KO won the "Best Tech Award" for leverless fight sticks , while Haute Pad T-Series won "Best Custom Hardware" for their affordable leverless options with constant quality updates. These endorsements from the fighting game community's premier event highlight the most respected brands in leverless technology. The Victrix Pro KO represents the premium tier of leverless controllers. Designed with input from professional players, it features tournament-grade components and official PlayStation licensing for competitive events. The controller includes hot-swappable Cherry MX Speed Silver RGB switches, 16 movable and mappable buttons, and a removable aluminum top plate for customization. Market Reality and Pricing The leverless controller market spans a wide price range. Premium devices like the Victrix Pro KO cost approximately $250-300 . This price diversity ensures players can find leverless options matching their budget, though all represent significant investments compared to standard controllers. Community experts consistently recommend leverless controllers for their customization options, with models featuring hot-swappable switches, customizable button layouts, and RGB lighting becoming standard features. These customization capabilities allow players to fine-tune their controllers for optimal performance and personal preference. Understanding the Learning Curve and Transition Tips Arcade Joystick Alternative Adaptation Even fighting game veterans find leverless controllers challenging initially. Professional fighting game players report that while the controllers are "simultaneously intuitive and unintuitive," there's a significant learning curve despite the controllers being more fun than expected once mastered. The transition requires rewiring decades of muscle memory built around joystick manipulation. Initial Challenges : New leverless users struggle with basic movement during matches, as jumping forward or backward requires pressing two buttons simultaneously (Up + Right or Up + Left), which requires significant mental processing adjustment. Complex special moves that combine quarter-circles with half-circles can feel nearly impossible initially, with some players reporting successful execution only through "pure luck" during early practice sessions. Gradual Improvement : While performing special attacks, from fireballs to sonic booms, becomes easier than expected with practice, players typically need several weeks to develop basic proficiency. The key is consistent practice with simple movements before attempting complex combo sequences. Transition Strategy Professional players recommend starting with single-player training modes to build muscle memory without competitive pressure. Begin with basic movements, forward, back, jumping, before progressing to special move inputs. The precision of leverless controllers makes perfect practice more achievable than on traditional arcade sticks. Leverless Controllers Beyond Fighting Games: Other Genres Adoption While fighting games drove leverless controller development, other competitive genres are recognizing their advantages. Precise fighting game inputs translate directly to benefits in platform games, retro arcade titles, and rhythm games where frame-perfect timing matters. Platform Gaming : Tight platforming games benefit from leverless controllers because short inputs can be accomplished easily with buttons, making precise movement more consistent than analog sticks. The digital precision eliminates issues with analog stick dead zones or sensitivity curves. Retro Gaming : Retro gaming feels more authentic on leverless controllers, providing the digital input response that classic arcade games were designed around. Modern analog sticks often feel imprecise when playing games designed for digital joystick inputs. Rhythm Games : The tactile feedback and consistent response of arcade-style buttons make leverless controllers excellent for rhythm games requiring precise timing. The elimination of joystick travel time ensures that timing-critical inputs register exactly when intended. Challenges and Controversies Around Leverless Controllers Tournament Regulation Changes The rise of leverless controllers has prompted significant rule changes in professional competition. Capcom's Capcom Pro Tour introduced strict rules addressing leverless controller advantages , particularly around Simultaneous Opposing Cardinal Directions (SOCD) inputs. These changes ensure competitive balance between different controller types. SOCD Considerations : Leverless controllers can register up and down inputs simultaneously, while traditional controllers typically register neutral when opposing directions are pressed together. This difference provided leverless users with execution advantages that tournament organizers needed to address through rule standardization. Historical Context : The controversy reached a peak in 2019 when Daigo Umehara's custom Gafrobox controller was banned from Capcom Pro Tour events just before Combo Breaker. The Gafrobox used "Last Win" SOCD cleaning, which provided significant advantages for charge characters. This incident led to clearer tournament regulations for leverless controllers. Rule Standardization : Major tournaments like EVO Japan now explicitly allow leverless controllers while prohibiting macro functions and multiple inputs wired to single buttons. These rules ensure that leverless advantages come from design efficiency rather than programmable shortcuts. Competitive Balance Concerns Professional players have mixed opinions on the leverless controller. EVO 2018 champion Problem X noted that previous versions of Hit Box controllers gave "significant advantages" for charge characters, allowing players to maintain charge while performing other actions impossible on traditional controllers. Rule changes aimed at "normalizing rather than nerfing" these advantages. Access and Cost : Premium leverless controllers can cost $250-400, creating potential barriers for newer players compared to traditional arcade sticks or standard controllers. However, community reviews highlight that budget options are increasingly available, democratizing access to leverless technology. Professional Adoption Reality : Despite media attention, tournament data shows that before recent years, "no pro using any type of Hit Box controller had ever won a major CPT event". Professional adoption remains measured rather than overwhelming, with success achieved across all controller types. The Future of Competitive Gaming Controllers Fighting Game Controllers 2025 Trends 2025 is being described as an exciting year for fightsticks and leverless releases, with manufacturers expanding into Switch and Xbox leverless controllers. The market is rapidly expanding beyond fighting game niches into broader competitive gaming applications. Innovation Acceleration : Modern leverless controllers feature hot-swappable switches, RGB lighting, and 1ms input response times, setting new standards for competitive gaming hardware. These features represent the convergence of gaming keyboard technology with fighting game controller design. Platform Integration : Universal compatibility is becoming standard, with most premium leverless controllers supporting PlayStation, Xbox, PC, and Nintendo Switch through single devices or adapter systems. This flexibility ensures broad accessibility across gaming platforms . Mainstream Adoption Predictions Tournament data shows that all three controller styles, stick, pad, and leverless, remain viable at the highest competitive levels. This suggests that leverless controllers will continue growing as an alternative rather than a replacement for traditional arcade sticks. Specialization Over Dominance : Like how racing wheels excel for driving games while general controllers serve broader needs, leverless controllers are establishing their niche in precision-demanding competitive titles rather than universally replacing traditional options. Educational Impact : As fighting game education becomes more sophisticated, leverless controllers offer clearer feedback for learning precise inputs. New players can more easily understand and replicate complex techniques when button presses provide unambiguous feedback. The Future of Competitive Gaming Controllers The rise of leverless controllers represents more than a technological advancement; it's a paradigm shift toward precision-focused competitive gaming hardware. EVO tournament data demonstrates that leverless controllers have achieved competitive parity with traditional arcade sticks, establishing them as legitimate tools for professional competition. Advantages of leverless controllers , speed, precision, and ergonomics, address fundamental limitations of traditional arcade hardware. These benefits extend beyond fighting games into any competitive scenario where input precision and consistency matter. The growing adoption among pro gamers' leverless setup configurations proves that serious competitors recognize these advantages, though adoption remains more measured than revolutionary. The Victrix Pro KO's recognition at the EVO Awards demonstrates the technology's maturation and acceptance within the competitive community. However, the learning curve and cost considerations mean leverless controllers complement rather than replace traditional options. The future of competitive gaming controllers is diverse and specialized. Traditional arcade sticks retain their charm and effectiveness, standard controllers remain accessible and versatile, while leverless controllers offer unmatched precision for dedicated competitors. This diversity strengthens the competitive gaming ecosystem by providing options that match different playstyles, preferences, and budgets. Leverless controllers aren't replacing traditional arcade sticks; they're expanding the toolkit available to competitive gamers. As the technology continues maturing and costs decrease, more players will have access to the precision and consistency advantages that today's professionals enjoy. The evolution continues, and the competitive gaming landscape benefits from this innovation while maintaining respect for traditional approaches. FAQ What is a leverless controller? A leverless controller is a fighting game controller that replaces the traditional arcade joystick with individual buttons for directional inputs. Instead of moving a physical stick, players press dedicated left, down, right, and up buttons for movement while using standard arcade buttons for attacks. The Victrix Pro KO Leverless Fight Stick exemplifies this design with 16 customizable buttons and tournament-grade components. How does a leverless controller differ from an arcade joystick? Leverless controllers use digital button inputs for all directions, eliminating the physical travel time and potential imprecision of analog joysticks. This provides zero travel time between directional changes and ensures perfectly consistent input registration, unlike arcade sticks, which require physical movement between positions. Why do professional gamers prefer leverless controllers? Professional players choose leverless controllers for their execution speed, input consistency, and ergonomic benefits. The elimination of joystick travel time enables faster combo execution, while digital precision reduces missed inputs during critical tournament moments. Extended play sessions also cause less hand and wrist fatigue. Are leverless controllers better for fighting games? Leverless controllers offer specific advantages for fighting games, including faster execution of complex inputs and greater consistency in directional movements. However, tournament data shows that traditional arcade sticks, standard controllers, and leverless options all remain viable at the highest competitive levels, making personal preference and comfort equally important factors. Can beginners use leverless controllers effectively? While leverless controllers offer precision advantages, they require a significant learning curve even for experienced fighting game players. Beginners must develop new muscle memory for button-based movement, which can initially feel counterintuitive. However, the precision and consistency benefits can accelerate skill development once players adapt to the button layout.

title: Craftwork's Expert Exterior Painting Process
summary: Increase your home's value and overall appearance with Craftwork's exterior painting team.
body_text: Craftwork's Expert Exterior Painting Process Increase your home's value and overall appearance with Craftwork's exterior painting team. Finally ready for that refresh you've been begging your partner for? So are we! Exterior painting is our bread and butter and we have nailed this process down to a T. We're here to paint your dream exterior quickly and seamlessly resulting in absolutely stunning results. Your home is about to become the envy of the neighborhood, and we can't wait to get started! Booking Your Project Couple holding up paint swatches to select from First things first, let's take a look at your project. We've streamlined our estimation process to fit into your busy schedule, all while maintaining our commitment to accuracy and transparency. Using photos of your home from Zillow along with square footage details, we apply our standard pricing model to provide you with a detailed estimate without stepping foot on your property. This pricing includes all prep, paint, and Labor (Sherwin-Williams brand paints.) Once approved, we'll pick the best time to start your project and you will select your new home's color palette! If this is the scariest part for you, we've got a list of our top exterior paint colors guaranteed to boost your home's value. Reminder : The outside temperature must be above 55 degrees in order for the paint to adhere properly. We will reschedule your project if the forecast doesn't meet this requirement. Deciding What To Paint A few diagrams to help you determine what needs to be painted. Step 1: Prepping Like Pros Now that your booked, it's time to get started! As with any of our projects, 90% of our work is in the preparation. No matter what your home is wearing (Vinyl, Wood, Composite, Brick, Stone—you name it), our team meticulously prepares your home's exterior for the long haul. All we ask of you is to cut shrubbery back from the house and remove all objects that could interfere with our crew's access to the project area. Cleaning: The first step is to power wash the exterior to remove dirt, mildew, and loose paint. This step ensures a clean surface for the paint to adhere to. Depending on the size of the house, it can take 2-4 hours to pressure wash and is included in your estimate. Man power washing exterior of house Repairs and Sanding: Next we repair any cracks, nail pops, or damages that were agreed upon in our contract. This includes repairing small wood issues, re-caulking cracks and gaps, and scraping peeling paint. Rough spots are sanded down to ensure an even surface. Man caulking exterior of home Protection: We take measures to protect your landscaping, windows, gutters, and non-painted surfaces. This includes covering vulnerable areas with plastic sheets, protecting walkways with masking paper, and using painter's tape to shield windows and trim. Linear masking is used to protect surfaces that are not being painted from those that are, i.e., a brick skirt on the house below the painted siding. Man cover walkway to home with masking paper Step 2: Painting The Exterior Here's where we get to the fun stuff. Needed areas are spot primed to ensure the paint adheres well and lasts longer. We apply a special primer to a porous concrete surface. You'll need to do this for all brick, concrete, or cinder block surfaces before painting if they haven't been painted before. During the paint selection step, we ensure the proper paint is chosen so we've got the right tools and techniques to get that paint on smoothly and evenly. We start with the big surfaces, moving on to the trim, doors, and those special touches that make your home, well, yours. We always apply at least two coats of paint to ensure a vibrant, even, and durable finish. Step 3: Clean-Up Crew Once the painting is complete, we conduct a thorough clean-up of the work area, removing all equipment, materials, and protective coverings. We ensure your property is left neat and tidy, just the way it was. The final step in our process is a detailed inspection of the work. This ensures that the project meets your expectations and our high standards. We address any concerns you may have and make necessary touch-ups. Ready for it? At Craftwork, we're not just about slapping on a coat of paint. We're about creating a connection with you and your home, making sure every brushstroke adds to the story of your space. Ready for a change? Let's chat and make your home the talk of the neighborhood.

title: Evercore Wealth Management Names Kait Oliveira as Managing Director, Portfolio Manager
summary: Evercore names Kait Oliveira as Managing Director and Portfolio Manager serving UHNW clients.
body_text: Evercore Wealth Management today announced the appointment of Kait Oliveira as Managing Director and Portfolio Manager. She advises ultra high net worth families, business owners, financial professionals, and senior corporate executives, delivering tailored investment strategies that integrate disciplined portfolio construction with deep investment analysis, to help clients grow and preserve wealth across generations. Ms. Oliveira joined Evercore in 2025 from Clarfeld Wealth Partners at Citizens Private Wealth, where she served as an investment manager and a private wealth advisor. She earlier worked at J.P. Morgan Private Bank as a client advisor, an investment professional, and an analyst. “We are happy to welcome Kait to our national firm,” said Chris Zander, CEO of Evercore Wealth Management and Evercore Trust Company. “Her experience in helping individuals and families define and achieve their financial goals, along with her investment expertise, makes her a natural fit for our firm.” Ms. Oliveira earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a concentration in Financial Market Regulation from the University at Albany, State University of New York. She holds both the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) and Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designations. Ms. Oliveira is based at the New York headquarters of Evercore Wealth Management and Evercore Trust Company.
